items.text:
I'm having to write a negative review for a game I'd really wish I could recommend. And I really want to recommend this. Maybe if the issues I mention get addressed, i'll revisit this review. If you're looking for a game that includes ship harvesting and ship building, I recommend Cosmoteer or Startdeus instead.

[h1]The Review - The Good Parts[/h1]
[b]1.[/b] Before I go ANY FURTHER, I was to say that the community is one of the best I've ever seen. When I posted on one of the Quill18 videos that I was two days into the game and felt like I was going to post a negative review, only one person did the gatekeeping dismissal by telling me "This game isn't for you, because it's not going to hold your hand." Everyone else either posted suggestions for me to try or commiserated over getting stuck in the game for the same and/or similar reasons. And all the comments under his videos of the game and on the internet have been the same. I know plenty of games that deserve a fanbase like this.

[b]2.[/b] Some of the game systems are quite enjoyable. So long as I didn't encounter any of the game breaking bugs and poorly thought-out features that renders playthroughs dead, I really did enjoy flying out to derelicts, breaking them down, figuring out what I could fly back (Before I expanded the ship), fixing it up, and selling it off once I got to OKLA station/K-LEG. Even playing Storage Tetris isn't a tiring exercise. Sadly, I didn't get to see other options, like the RPG elements or inter-planetary travel, mostly because issues with the game really hemmed me in to sticking with what I knew worked.

[b]3.[/b] The art in the game is great. And it looks like the dev used community created art for the loading screens and interactive story dump screen. And if I read the screens correctly, it looks like they gave the name of the work and credited the artist. (I can't say if or what the compensation was for the works. But at least they're credited.)

[b]4.[/b] Some of the mechanical choices are fun as well. The parts of the character selection screen I did enjoy was the backstory generator. Mind you, it needs a lot more work and a lot more material. But it was an interesting touch. Likewise, opening the control panels on devices to wire them up to other components was a nice touch.


[h1] The Review - The "Meh, It's Fine" Parts[/h1]
Had to remove a chunk because of character limits. Your Milage May Vary.

[h1]The Review - The Hair Ripping Parts[/h1]
[b]1.[/b] The Game Breaking Bugs and Features - When I say "Game Breaking", I'm not talking about constantly crashing to desktop or locking up so hard you have to use the Task List to kill it. Nope. The game’s fairly stable. In 105 hours of game play (as of this review), I only encountered such an issue ONCE. No, these are broken or poorly implemented features that either outright end your current run or force you to go back to an older save to avoid the issue before it became an issue. Things like your character not able to clear a condition causing your character to black out and hit the deck every five seconds because your character is blacking out and hitting the deck every five seconds. Or that the ONLY way to clear a wanted status despite paying the fine already is to get arrested and thrown in jail. Except that you're a wanted criminal scum that they've determined to shoot on sight. Mind you, the crime was not undocking from a wreck or undocking fast enough from a wreck, even though you were probably neck deep in a salvage operation and the beep for the police is the same beep as every fricken person who wants a chunk of your time. I swear it's like the Dev took the 2024 US DoJ 126 page report on the abuses of the City of Phoenix Police Department and said, "Hold mah beer!" Really don't need this level of aggression in a game when I could get it stepping outside of my house.

[b]2.[/b] This game fails to communicate and educate the player on all three levels:
[b]2.1.[/b] The Tutorial - The tutorial is just a series of pop ups in the bottom left corner of the screen. They look exactly like any other task you might get, so you don't know if it's something you should be doing or ignoring for later. And most of those boxes tell you to do something, but they don't tell you HOW to do that something. The Dev expects you to just figure it out. (Or try to locate all the poorly written manuals as PDFs... except they do a poor job of telling you about them. There's going to be a lot of "stumbling on to..." situations.) You're looking to YouTube and Reddit for tutorials. (I recommend MO Chad on YouTube. QUill18 is good because a lot of comments to his videos are telling him "How To".

[b]2.2.[/b] The Game does not follow its own design language. The game spends time setting up the experience on various systems, only to break those experiences later in the game. Take objects. Take containers. You learn early on that your backpack (a container) can be accessed by right clicking on it and selecting "Inventory". Then you find out racks (more containers) can be accessed by right clicking and then selecting "Inventory". Then you find other objects (like chargers and tools that use batteries) are containers and can be "opened up" by right clicking and selecting "Inventory". Delightfully simple system that's used everywhere... not really. Got to fill up your O2 bottle for the suit? Drop it under a vent, access the control panel, switch the panel to on, and repeat until you stop blowing up bottles. Need to fill up containers involving liquids? Put the container in your hand, then right click on the sink and look for the "Dispense Liquid" option. This inconsistency will drive you nuts.

[b]2.3.[/b] The Game's UI has a problem communicating relevant information to the player. For example, one of the game breaking features of the game is getting the Black-Out condition every 30 seconds or so. The game does not tell you how you got the condition or how to clear it. If you're lucky, either you remember being thrown violently and repeatedly to the point of getting a concussion or your sleep gauge is high and red. But even if you know how to fix the sleep issue (I'm still trying to figure out how to fix the concussion.), you may not be able to get yourself to a bed to sleep it off because you keep blacking out on the way to the bed. (By the way, the sleep mechanic is broken as well, as six hours sleep should do a number to the sleep bar.) The game does a poor job telling you that you've got a wanted status. (It's visible on the transponder, if you ever look at the transponder, then it's a beat-down and shooting by the police.) Even the status gauges don't operate the same way or communicate issues clearly. (Just watch the Quill18 series to see a veteran programmer keep questioning what the UI is saying.)

[b]3.[/b] The game has performance issues. As you play the game, the game will start bogging down. It gets to the point you will need to save your game and cycle the game to clear out the memory. (Dev. Visual Basic has garbage clearing routines. This isn't acceptable.)

Yes, this game is in Early Access. But it entered EA in Sept. 2020, and it's Sept. 2024. That's four years. And the dev's "Road Map" says the game will be released in 2025. (It's really a poster version of South Park's Underwear gnomes graphic of "Step 1. Do the thing. Step 2. ????? Step 3. Profit".) There is no excuse for a lot of these issues in a game that's been in EA for over four years, or a game that expects to release to a 1.0 version in the next year.

我不得不给一款我真心希望能推荐给大家的游戏写一篇负面评测。我真的很想推荐这款游戏。也许如果我所提到的问题得到解决，我会重新审视这篇评测。如果你在找一款包含船只拆解和船只建造的游戏，我反而推荐《Cosmoteer》或《Startdeus》。

[h1]评测——优点部分[/h1]
[b]1.[/b] 在我继续往下说之前，我想说这个社区是我见过的最好的社区之一。当我在Quill18的一个视频下留言说，我玩这游戏才两天，就觉得自己要发一篇负面评测时，只有一个人用那种守门式的轻蔑态度对我说：“这游戏不适合你，因为它不会手把手教你。”其他所有人要么给我发来可以尝试的建议，要么就和我一起吐槽因为相同和/或类似的原因卡在游戏里。而他那些游戏视频下面以及网上的所有评论也都是这样。我知道有很多游戏配得上这样的粉丝群体。

[b]2.[/b] 游戏的一些系统相当令人愉快。只要我没遇到那些让整个流程直接报废的破坏性bug和考虑不周的功能，我真的很享受飞到废弃船只那里，把它们拆解，琢磨我能带什么回去（在我扩建飞船之前），把它修好，然后等我到达OKLA空间站/K-LEG后把它卖掉。就连玩“仓库俄罗斯方块”也不是一件累人的事。遗憾的是，我没能体验到其他选项，比如RPG元素或星际旅行，主要是因为游戏的问题真的把我限制在了我知道行得通的那套玩法里。

[b]3.[/b] 游戏的美术很棒。而且看起来开发者使用了社区创作的画作作为加载界面和互动故事倾倒界面的美术。如果我读屏幕上的信息没读错的话，看起来他们给出了作品名称并标注了艺术家。（我无法说这些作品是否有报酬或报酬是什么。但至少他们被署名了。）

[b]4.[/b] 一些机制上的选择也很有趣。角色选择界面中我确实喜欢的部分是背景故事生成器。当然，它需要更多的工作和更多的素材。但这是一个有趣的细节。同样，打开设备上的控制面板把它们连接到其他组件也是一个不错的细节。


[h1] 评测——“嗯，还行吧”的部分[/h1]
因为字数限制不得不删掉一大段。你的体验可能有所不同。

[h1]评测——让人抓狂的部分[/h1]
[b]1.[/b] 破坏游戏的bug和功能——当我说“破坏游戏”时，我不是在说不断崩溃到桌面或者卡死到必须用任务列表来杀掉它。不。游戏相当稳定。在105小时的游戏时间中（截至这篇评测），我只遇到过一次这样的问题。不，我说的是那些要么直接终结你当前这局游戏，要么迫使你回到较早的存档、在问题变成问题之前就避开它的那些损坏或实现糟糕的功能。比如你的角色无法清除某个状态，导致你的角色每五秒就昏过去并摔倒在地，因为你的角色每五秒就昏过去并摔倒在地。或者，尽管你已经付了罚款，清除通缉状态的唯一方法却是被逮捕并扔进监狱。只不过你是个被通缉的罪犯渣滓，他们认定要见到就开枪。请注意，罪行不是从一艘废弃船只上脱离停靠，或者从一艘废弃船只上脱离停靠得不够快，即使你当时很可能正深陷打捞作业之中，而警察的提示音和每一个想占用你时间的该死的家伙的提示音是同一个声音。我发誓这就像开发者拿来了2024年美国司法部关于凤凰城警察局滥用职权的那份126页报告，然后说：“扶好我的啤酒！”我真的不需要在一款游戏里体验这种程度的攻击性，我走出家门就能遇到。

[b]2.[/b] 这款游戏在三个层面上都未能向玩家传达信息和进行教学：
[b]2.1.[/b] 教程——教程只是屏幕左下角的一系列弹窗。它们看起来和你可能接到的任何其他任务一模一样，所以你根本不知道这是你该做的事还是该忽略留到以后做的事。而且这些框大多告诉你要做某件事，却不告诉你该怎么做那件事。开发者指望你自己琢磨出来。（或者试着去找那些写得糟糕的PDF手册……只不过他们在告诉你这些手册存在这件事上做得很差。会有很多“偶然发现……”的情况。）你只能去YouTube和Reddit找教程。（我推荐YouTube上的MO Chad。QUill18也不错，因为他视频下的很多评论都在告诉他“怎么做”。

[b]2.2.[/b] 游戏不遵循自己的设计语言。游戏花时间在各种系统上建立起一套体验，结果却在游戏后期打破这些体验。拿物品来说。拿容器来说。你很早就学到，你的背包（一个容器）可以通过右键点击它并选择“物品栏”来访问。然后你发现货架（更多容器）可以通过右键点击然后选择“物品栏”来访问。然后你发现其他物品（比如充电器和用电池的工具）也是容器，可以通过右键点击并选择“物品栏”来“打开”。令人愉快地简单的系统，到处都在用……才不是呢。要给宇航服充满氧气瓶？把它放在通风口下面，访问控制面板，把面板切换到开启，然后重复直到你不再把瓶子炸掉。需要给装液体的容器加满？把容器拿在手里，然后右键点击水槽，寻找“分配液体”选项。这种不一致会把你逼疯。

[b]2.3.[/b] 游戏的UI在向玩家传达相关信息方面有问题。例如，游戏中一个破坏游戏的功能是大约每30秒就获得一次“昏厥”状态。游戏不告诉你你是怎么得到这个状态的，也不告诉你如何清除它。如果你运气好，要么你记得自己被猛烈地反复摔来摔去直到脑震荡，要么你的睡眠条很高而且是红色的。但即使你知道如何解决睡眠问题（我还在努力弄清楚怎么治脑震荡。），你也可能无法把自己弄到床上去睡一觉来消除它，因为你在去床上的路上不断昏过去。（顺便说一句，睡眠机制也是坏的，因为睡六个小时应该对睡眠条有很大影响。）游戏在告诉你你处于通缉状态这件事上做得很差。（它在应答器上可见，如果你会去看应答器的话，然后就是被警察暴打和开枪。）就连状态条也不以相同的方式运作，或者清晰地传达问题。（只要看看Quill18的系列视频，就能看到一位资深程序员不断质疑UI在说什么。）

[b]3.[/b] 游戏有性能问题。随着你玩下去，游戏会开始变得卡顿。它会到那种你需要保存游戏并重启游戏来清理内存的地步。（开发者。Visual Basic有垃圾清理例程。这是不可接受的。）

是的，这款游戏处于抢先体验阶段。但它在2020年9月进入EA，而现在是2024年9月。那是四年。而开发者的“路线图”说游戏将在2025年发布。（它真的就是《南方公园》内裤地精那张“第一步。做那件事。第二步。？？？？？第三步。赚钱”的图的海报版。）对于一款已经在EA待了四年多的游戏，或者一款期望在明年发布1.0版本的游戏来说，很多这些问题都是没有借口的。

Update: I've played a bit more since my initial review and while I think I overreacted previously, the gameplay loop quickly gets stale.

This game is barely functional and has no interest in telling you how its mechanics work or giving you a reason to want to learn how they work. Constant beeping from 20 different consoles that means nothing also really gets on my nerves after awhile.

items.text:
Wow!  This game has fantastic potential.  It hits something I've been wanting for a long time.  A gritty space sim where you crawl your way out of oppression through any means necessary... and it can surely be a grind... but as you find / build a more sustainable, more comfortable existence... it feels tangible and rewarding.  
 
Want to be a derelict ship salvager… check, want to work in refurbishing, buying damaged goods and selling higher, check… want to run cargo between stations working the economy... check.  Want to do gig work investigating murders and transporting special cargo… check.  Want to attack civilians and take of their hard earned efforts, check.  Want nuanced, impactful NPC interactions… check… Want to hire a crew to help you with any of the above, check.  And I should add… that all this simply feels like the groundwork.  It’s easy to see that there will be so much more.  However, in its current EA state… its still quite rough.  

Basically, there are a lot of jank and pathing issues.  For example, one of my character employees decided he needed to relieve himself.  Inside the ship... inside the safety of the pressurized, oxygenated cabin where he could safely remove his space suit and take care of that... instead, as he tries, I get an error message saying he can't while "airtight."  I think... ok, not bad... I can see why that might be important in some situations.  EXCEPT, then he walks out onto a derelict... unpressurized, bathroom... exposed to the vacuum of space... and then THROUGH his airtight suit... uses the bathroom.  Funny.  Essentially, the AI and game seems to lag / bog down or get more easily confused as your ship gets bigger and / or the tasks assigned become more complicated.  


Graphically the game is cute.  It captures a lot of detail about a wide range of parts… all of which can be interacted with in some way.  Some of the parts themselves could use some more detail… ie… do different hull types have different hp values, etc, but the look of the game is great.   

UI / Combat – This took some adjusting, but you start to appreciate the choices available… all things are done through narrative choices.  You choose your actions step by step in dialogue, in combat, and possibly other situations.   Also, I highly undervalued, at first, how relatable and engaging it was to see your character face and emotions (sometimes a bit over the top, but better than the standard nothing) 

Some suggestions for the Devs – More… more stuff… more reasons… better progression.  Suits could have Modular additions that enhance different things like movement or radiation resistance.  Different types of engines with different focuses and values.   Cooking would fit well in some fashion… as well as hydroponics that you can grow on your ship.  (Not looking for a farm sim, but some basics could be very congruent.) 

The learning curve is rather steep… and the found manuals in the game are DENSE… if you want to understand the Environmental settings for your ship, set up a better power supply, or learn about any number of other systems you must read… actual… in game… manuals.  No tutorials on this stuff yet as far as I know.  I understand the point and the added immersion, but a compromise might be good here.  The manuals might have linked tables of contents that flip you to the correct information / paragraph.  

Better interactions with your ship crew would be useful.   From the navigation console, for example, being able to issue ship wide instructions like … “prepare for departure” or “Prepare to be boarded.”

Piracy and Combat – This could do with another way to board another ship… or infiltrate a station.  Drop pods that burst through wall of a ship after some challenge similar to docking.  Also, a single pirate would likely be a bit more cautious than boldly walking onto a docked vessel with a crew of four gun wielding opponents.  This surely needs some balancing.  Being able to loot actually currency in ships seems like it would be useful as well.  Likewise, looking forward to seeing what the game does with the promised ship to ship.  

All in all, I do recommend this game based upon its potential.  Understand, though, that this is with the caveat that it is still noticeably early access and has many unfinished and unpolished systems.  If you want to support the devs in its current state, buy it now and give feedback… otherwise check back in some months as it is getting regular updates.  

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As my hours might show, I've been playing this game quite a lot again.  First of all!   Much less jank.  A lot of the issues I mentioned before have been resolved or folded into in a way that feels authentic.  The game is making steady progress.   

What I'd like to see now is more in depth characters.  The dialogue options have a certain charm, but I think that they could be more robust or character relevant.  As it stands they feel a bit generic.... not to say that 100% unique is expected all the time, but more differentiation here would help distinguish NPCs.  On a similar note, more developed factions, standings with factions, missions, intrigue, alliances, and shades of gray... all could be fleshed out more.  Much in the way NPCs can be more readily Identifiable  and differentiable.   

It could also be nice to have different starts - i.e maybe instead of starting in debt to the bank paying off a ship that was your only way forward, maybe you start indebted to the crime / pirate syndicates around Venus or another faction in one way or another.   Or maybe you're not in debt at all... maybe the story derives even more from the choices you choose crafting your character.  

Either way... Mechanically speaking.  The grind to get a fusion reactor working on your ship is very long... especially if you don't understand it.  The manuals explain it decently, but it could be a bit better.  A subtle thing that might help with this could be that players can observe functioning ships with fully operational fusion systems earlier on, but have no access... or any attempt to steal a currently active ship would have serious consequences.  

Lastly, the crime system ( as well as the means and reasons to commit crime)  and law enforcement could be enhanced a bit.   I know the punishments increase in some other places, but its easy to exploit kleg a bit.   In addition, on the other hand, it would be fun if you could actually take over places from factions, by killing enough, but exploits like shoving them back by placing doors would have to be fixed first.  Also, it could also be that a place you control, if you've taken something over, could have attacks from factions.  

Anyway, 

Great Progress and can't wait to see more.
items.text_zh:
哇！这款游戏潜力巨大。它触及了我长久以来一直想要的东西。一个硬核的太空模拟游戏，你通过任何必要的手段从压迫中挣扎出来……这肯定可能很肝……但当你找到/建立起一种更可持续、更舒适的生活时……它感觉是实实在在的、有回报的。

想当一名废弃飞船打捞者……可以；想从事翻新工作，买受损货物再高价卖出……可以；想在空间站之间跑货运、玩转经济……可以。想接零工调查谋杀案、运送特殊货物……可以。想攻击平民、夺走他们辛苦赚来的成果……可以。想要细腻、有影响力的NPC互动……可以……想雇佣一支船员来帮你完成上述任何事……可以。我还应该补充……这一切感觉只是基础。很容易看出还会有更多内容。然而，在目前的EA状态下……它仍然相当粗糙。

基本上，有很多毛病和寻路问题。例如，我的一个角色员工决定他需要解手。在飞船里……在加压、供氧的舱室安全环境中，他可以安全地脱下太空服来处理这件事……结果，当他尝试时，我收到一条错误信息，说他在“气密”状态下不能这么做。我想……好吧，不错……我能理解为什么在某些情况下这很重要。但是，然后他走到一艘废弃飞船上……未加压的、厕所……暴露在太空真空中……然后透过他的气密服……上了厕所。好笑。本质上，随着你的飞船变大和/或分配的任务变得更复杂，AI和游戏似乎会卡顿/变慢或更容易混乱。


从画面来看，游戏很可爱。它捕捉了各种部件的许多细节……所有这些部件都能以某种方式互动。有些部件本身可以再多些细节……比如……不同船体类型是否有不同的生命值等等，但游戏的外观很棒。

UI/战斗——这需要一些适应，但你会开始欣赏可用的选择……所有事情都通过叙事选择来完成。你在对话、战斗以及可能其他情况中一步步选择你的行动。另外，我一开始严重低估了看到你的角色面部和情绪（有时有点夸张，但总比标准的什么都没有好）是多么有共鸣和吸引人。

给开发者的一些建议——更多……更多东西……更多理由……更好的进程。太空服可以有模块化附加装置，增强不同方面，比如移动或抗辐射能力。不同类型的引擎有不同的侧重点和数值。烹饪在某种程度上会很合适……还有可以在飞船上种植的水培。（不是想要农场模拟，但一些基础内容会非常契合。）

学习曲线相当陡峭……而且游戏中找到的手册非常密集……如果你想了解飞船的环境设置、建立更好的电源，或学习任何其他系统，你必须阅读……真正的……游戏内……手册。据我所知，目前还没有关于这些东西的教程。我理解其用意和增加的沉浸感，但折中方案可能不错。手册可以有链接目录，让你翻到正确的信息/段落。

与飞船船员更好的互动会很有用。例如，从导航控制台，能够发布全船指令，比如……“准备出发”或“准备接舷”。

海盗行为和战斗——这可以再有另一种登上另一艘船的方式……或潜入空间站。在类似对接的某种挑战后，用投放舱冲破飞船墙壁。另外，一个海盗很可能比大胆走上停靠的船只、面对四名持枪对手的船员要谨慎一些。这肯定需要一些平衡。能够掠夺飞船上的实际货币似乎也会很有用。同样，期待看到游戏在承诺的船对船方面会有什么表现。

总而言之，基于其潜力，我确实推荐这款游戏。但请理解，这是有前提的，即它仍明显处于抢先体验阶段，有许多未完成和未打磨的系统。如果你想在目前状态下支持开发者，现在就买并给出反馈……否则过几个月再回来看看，因为它正在定期更新。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

从我的游戏时长可以看出，我又玩了很多这款游戏。首先！毛病少多了。我之前提到的很多问题已经解决，或以感觉真实的方式融入了。游戏正在稳步进展。

我现在想看到的是更有深度的角色。对话选项有一定的魅力，但我认为它们可以更丰富或更与角色相关。就目前而言，它们感觉有点通用……不是说一直期望100%独特，但这里更多的差异化会有助于区分NPC。类似地，更发达的派系、与派系的关系、任务、阴谋、联盟和灰色地带……都可以进一步充实。就像NPC可以更容易被识别和区分一样。

有不同的开局也会不错——比如，也许不是一开始欠银行债务、要还清一艘你唯一前进之路的飞船，也许你一开始以某种方式欠金星周围的犯罪/海盗集团或另一个派系的债。或者也许你根本不欠债……也许故事更多地源自你塑造角色时所做的选择。

不管怎样……从机制上说。让飞船上的聚变反应堆运转起来的肝度非常长……尤其是如果你不理解它的话。手册解释得还算不错，但可以更好一点。一个可能有助于此的微妙之处是，玩家可以在早期观察到拥有完全运作聚变系统的飞船，但无法进入……或者任何试图偷窃一艘当前活跃飞船的行为都会有严重后果。

最后，犯罪系统（以及犯罪的手段和理由）和执法可以稍微增强。我知道在其他一些地方惩罚会增加，但很容易稍微利用kleg。此外，另一方面，如果你能通过杀足够多的人真正从派系手中接管地方，那会很有趣，但像通过放置门把他们推回去这样的漏洞必须先修复。另外，也可能是你控制的地方，如果你接管了什么，可能会遭到派系的攻击。

总之，

进步很大，迫不及待想看到更多。
发布全舰指令，比如……“准备出发”或“准备接舷。”

海盗行为与战斗——这方面可以再增加一种登上另一艘船……或潜入空间站的方式。投放舱在经历某种类似对接的挑战后冲破船体墙壁。另外，单个海盗很可能会比大胆地走进一艘停靠着的、船上有四名持枪对手的飞船更谨慎一些。这肯定需要一些平衡。能够掠夺飞船上的实际货币似乎也会很有用。同样，期待看到游戏如何处理承诺的船对船战斗。

总而言之，基于其潜力，我确实推荐这款游戏。但请理解，这是附带一个前提的，即它仍明显处于抢先体验阶段，有许多未完成和未打磨的系统。如果你想在其当前状态下支持开发者，现在就买并给出反馈……否则过几个月再回来看看，因为它正在定期更新。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

正如我的游戏时长可能显示的那样，我又玩了这款游戏相当多的时间。首先！卡顿少多了。我之前提到的很多问题已经解决，或以某种感觉真实的方式融入了游戏。游戏正在稳步推进。

我现在希望看到的是更有深度的角色。对话选项有一种特定的魅力，但我认为它们可以更丰富，或与角色更相关。就目前而言，它们感觉有点泛泛……不是说一直期待100%独一无二，但这里更多的差异化会有助于区分NPC。类似地，更发达的派系、与派系的关系、任务、阴谋、联盟和灰色地带……都可以进一步充实。就像NPC可以更容易被识别和区分那样。

有不同的开局也会不错——比如，也许不是一开始就欠银行债、要偿还一艘你唯一前进之路的飞船，也许你一开始以某种方式欠金星周围的犯罪/海盗辛迪加或另一个派系的债。或者也许你根本不欠债……也许故事更多地源自你塑造角色时所做的选择。

不管怎样……从机制上说。让你的飞船上的聚变反应堆运转起来的刷取过程非常漫长……尤其是在你不理解它的时候。手册解释得还算不错，但本可以更好一点。一个可能有助于此的细微之处是，玩家可以更早观察到拥有完全可用聚变系统的正常运转飞船，但无法进入……或者任何试图偷窃一艘当前活跃飞船的行为都会有严重后果。

最后，犯罪系统（以及犯罪的手段和理由）和执法可以稍微增强一些。我知道在其他一些地方惩罚会增加，但很容易稍微利用kleg。此外，另一方面，如果你能通过杀足够多的人真正从派系手中接管地点，那会很有趣，但像通过放置门把它们推回去这样的漏洞必须先修复。另外，也可能是，如果你接管了某个地方，你所控制的地点可能会遭到派系攻击。

总之，

进步很大，迫不及待想看到更多。

items.text:
I really want to like this game but elements of it's design just feel hostile. Character creation... I have absolutely no idea if I should try and maximise money and skills in the character creator or just play the game? I did a scavenging run and when I got back to the station I was arrested... Never told what I did wrong but now I have more debt (That's fine, I just wish I knew what I did?) Half of the scrap that I got I couldn't sell for some reason and I am not even sure how I begin to pay off my debts.

Plus I get stutters every 10 or so seconds which really grinds on you.

I won't refund but I think the devs need to just 100% focus on performance and clarity of information. Maybe have an opt in story driven tutorial where an experienced salvager takes you out on a mission and shows what you should even be looking for? Should I uninstall every single floor tile to get as much money as possible or get big items from multiple ships? No idea.

Cool idea that I want to get into but it just might be a bit too obtuse right now.
items.text_zh:
我真的很想喜欢这款游戏，但它设计中的一些元素就是让人感觉充满敌意。角色创建……我完全不知道我应该在角色创建器里试着把金钱和技能最大化，还是直接开始玩游戏？我做了一次拾荒跑，等我回到空间站时就被逮捕了……从来没告诉我做错了什么，但现在我的债务更多了（这没关系，我只是希望我知道自己做了什么？）我拿到的一半废料因为某种原因卖不出去，我甚至不确定我该怎么开始还清债务。

另外我每隔10秒左右就会卡顿一次，这真的很折磨人。

我不会退款，但我认为开发者需要100%专注于性能和信息的清晰度。也许可以做一个可选择加入的剧情驱动教程，让一位经验丰富的打捞者带你执行一次任务，展示你究竟应该寻找什么？我是不是应该把每一块地板砖都拆下来以尽可能多赚钱，还是从多艘飞船上获取大件物品？完全不知道。

很酷的想法，我想深入其中，但现在它可能有点太晦涩难懂了。

observations.description: 玩家不清楚自己为何被捕、如何还债
observations.evidence: Never told what I did wrong but now I have more debt
observations.evidence_zh: 从没告诉我做错了什么，但现在我的债务更多了

items.text:
There is a good game here, but it's buggy. I would wait till most of it is worked out. 

The bugs are weird, you will try to target a ship, then try show it on map, but instead of showing the ship you're trying to target, it will select a station. It's weird little bugs like that, the quests are bugged and not functional. 

The game it self is pretty good, the art style is great and there is a lot to do in expanding your ship, after the first handfuls of striping other ships money doesn't become an issue and you can spend your time doing what ever you want. 

A lot is not explained, you will need to go through the first 10 or so hours confused about everything and how it works. After that you kinda get what is going on, the start can be rough when you have no money.

It's a thumbs up because the game has real good potential, but it's far from finished.
items.text_zh:
这里有一款好游戏，但它有bug。我会等到大部分问题被解决再说。

这些bug很奇怪，你会尝试锁定一艘飞船，然后尝试在地图上显示它，但它不会显示你试图锁定的那艘飞船，而是会选中一个空间站。就是这种奇怪的小bug，任务也有bug而且无法正常运作。

游戏本身相当不错，美术风格很棒，而且在扩展你的飞船方面有很多事可做，在最初剥了几艘其他飞船之后，钱就不再是问题，你可以把时间花在任何你想做的事情上。

很多东西都没有解释，你会在最初10个小时左右对一切以及它如何运作感到困惑。在那之后，你大概就明白是怎么回事了，当你没钱的时候开局可能会很艰难。

给好评是因为这款游戏有非常好的潜力，但它远未完成。

observations.description: 很多内容没有解释，前10小时会感到困惑
observations.evidence: A lot is not explained, you will need to go through the first 10 or so hours confused about everything and how it works
observations.evidence_zh: 很多东西都没有解释，你会在最初的10个小时左右对一切及其运作方式感到困惑

items.text: September 8th, 2024 - I just played .3 hours and I am considering a refund. The tutorial is TERRIBLE. If I am getting confused about how to put on clothes when I understand at the start how to get a dwarf to mine in Dwarf Fortress, something is wrong here. The tutorial needs serious work. But.. I'm going to keep the game. It's not much (to me at least. I know, to some people, it may be more) to see what becomes of it. The developers seem to be working on it a lot and perhaps it will shine for me one day. But today is not the day. I will return and update my review should it get better. But for now, have to go with thumbs down.
items.text_zh: 2024年9月8日——我刚玩了0.3小时，正在考虑退款。教程糟透了。如果我在《矮人要塞》里一开始就懂得如何让矮人去采矿，却在这里搞不懂怎么穿衣服，那这里肯定有问题。教程需要认真重做。但是……我还是会留着这款游戏。看看它以后会变成什么样，对我来说不算什么（至少对我来说是这样。我知道，对某些人来说，可能不止如此）。开发者似乎正在大量投入开发，也许有一天它会为我大放异彩。但今天不是那一天。如果它变好了，我会回来更新我的评测。但就目前而言，只能给差评。

items.text:
[h1]Not recommended[/h1]
[h2]Decent spaceflight component, but ground game is weak and worsened by abysmal documentation. Early access so may improve, but needs work and is in rough shape as of September 2024.[/h2]

This is a game I dearly wanted to like. Despite having problems with Neo Scavenger years back to the point where I put it aside and have yet to pick it back up, I bought this game (thankfully on sale) because it looked good.
It might be good. Unfortunately, there's no way to really tell.

[h2]It aims for the stars...[/h2]
This game aims high. It wants to be a highly detailed simulation (excellent) of spaceflight and salvage (even better) and gives you the opportunity to not just buy but customize and even build ships (now we're talking). 

[h3]Great spaceflight component [/h3]
The spaceflight is magnificent, with strong overtones of Apollo and Space Shuttle controls and mechanics but suitably sci-fi. It feels [i]real[/i], and that's a rarity in a casual, non-simulation title. It's suitably gritty and requires patience and precision, and it doesn't really lend itself to being incautious - but you have the freedom to be if you so choose.

[h2]...and misses in almost every way.[/h2]
Unfortunately, that's where the praise is going to end because the game as it stands is barely playable for several reasons. 
[h3]Zero documentation [/h3]
First of all, there's no documentation. No, I don't count a half-assembled wiki full of things the average player can intuit as documentation, and zero points for having a Discord. The "player manual" is five pages and almost all of them are useless. There's a tutorial, but although it gives you tasks to complete it [i]explains[/i] very little, leaving you to learn everything by trial and error. Beginner area? None, you're in the deep end from the start. Training period, guidance, anything of the sort? Just the bare-bones tutorial. (Great, I've created a zone out of a patch of random floor... why did I do that?) So you're left to figure out this detailed game on your own. There are fan-made guides on Steam that are doing a better job as manuals for this game than the developers are providing. Not good.
[h3]Weak ground game, unbelievably flawed task execution [/h3]
As good as the spaceflight is, that's how bad things are once you're on the ground. The UI is, to be polite, a wreck. It's overcomplicated and under-designed. In the tutorial, you're shown how to repair something. Okay, good. But applying that lesson to a broken pump I took off of my first derelict, my character proceded to [i]walk out an airlock into hard vacuum without a helmet on.[/i] Why? Because he needed mechanical parts and went to get them. Automatically. In space. Without a helmet. Quickly steered him back inside only for him to... [i]do it again.[/i]. Because he has to be manually told to cancel all of his tasks or he's going to keep trying to go back to auto the moment your manual inputs are done. So, yeah, not the best design and it really doesn't get better. Want to open up a floor storage bin? Click on it... and get the controls for a pump instead. Turns out you have to keep right-clicking to cycle items on (or near) that tile. Would've been helpful if that'd been covered in the tutorial. Too dark to see? Turn on your worklight. It's still too dark. Why? Because the light needs to be held, not clipped to your suit. I have a worklight I use all the time. You clip it to your belt and it lights up your work area. This is lost technology in the future.
[h3]No explanations for critical gameplay components [/h3]
Many things are alluded to but never explained or in any way apparent. Got hit with a $15,000 fine for illegal salvage, ending my game before it really started because I was already in debt from my ship and couldn't pay for fuel or fees. I know you can buy a permit to salvage legally but I've yet to find [i]where or how[/i]. Went to the wiki to find out, only to be told what a permit is (I knew that much). Bad documentation strikes again. There's combat in the game, but you're not told what's involved, there's no tutorial on those mechanics at all, and the UI is as opaque for those tasks as it is for every other, so good luck. When I got mugged, I kept tackling and whacking him with a hacksaw (because punching him wasn't doing a thing) until he finally agreed to surrender... and two minutes later he died, which is expected when you beat someone with a hacksaw in space, but was there a better way? Maybe? No way to know. 
[h3]Weak graphics for walking section [/h3]
And this is a [i]very[/i] minor gripe because I generally don't really care about graphics compared to gameplay, but the ground-game graphics are so atrocious they deserve mention. They wouldn't have flown in the late 1990s, let alone the 2020s. This isn't a retro pixel style. It's just plain bad. 

[h2]The Bottom Line[/h2]
This is a game that [i]should[/i] be at least good if not outstanding, and maybe with time and some more work it will be. I really do hope so. But for right now, the obtuse, clunky UI design and lack of meaningful documentation or tooltips means that playing it is more frustrating than fulfilling. This is a thumbs-down I really feel bad about because there's a lot of promise here and it's clear there's passion behind its development, but until some of the problems are fixed and the game goes through some more revisions, it's just not there yet.
items.text_zh:
[h1]不推荐[/h1]
[h2]太空飞行部分尚可，但地面玩法薄弱，且因糟糕透顶的文档而雪上加霜。抢先体验版，所以可能会改进，但需要打磨，截至2024年9月仍处于粗糙状态。[/h2]

这是一款我非常想喜欢的游戏。尽管多年前玩《Neo Scavenger》时遇到问题，以至于我把它搁置一旁至今未再拾起，我还是买了这款游戏（幸好是在打折时），因为它看起来不错。
它可能确实不错。不幸的是，根本无法真正判断。

[h2]它志在星辰……[/h2]
这款游戏目标远大。它想成为一款高度精细的太空飞行与打捞模拟（很棒），甚至更好，并且让你不仅能够购买，还能定制甚至建造飞船（这才像话）。

[h3]出色的太空飞行部分[/h3]
太空飞行非常壮观，带有强烈的阿波罗和航天飞机操控与机制的色彩，但又恰如其分地科幻。它感觉[i]真实[/i]，这在休闲、非模拟类游戏中实属罕见。它恰如其分地粗粝，需要耐心和精确，并不真正适合鲁莽行事——但如果你愿意，你有自由去鲁莽。

[h2]……却几乎在各方面都失手了。[/h2]
不幸的是，赞美到此为止，因为就目前而言，这款游戏由于几个原因几乎无法游玩。
[h3]零文档[/h3]
首先，没有文档。不，我不把那种拼凑了一半、满是普通玩家都能凭直觉猜到的东西的wiki算作文档，有Discord也一分不值。“玩家手册”只有五页，而且几乎全是没用的。有个教程，但尽管它给你任务去完成，它[i]解释[/i]的东西却极少，让你只能通过反复试错来学习一切。新手区？没有，你从一开始就身处深水区。训练期、引导、任何类似的东西？只有那个骨瘦如柴的教程。（太好了，我用一块随机地板创建了一个区域……我为什么要那样做？）所以你只能靠自己摸索这款细节丰富的游戏。Steam上有玩家自制的指南，作为这款游戏的手册，它们比开发者提供的做得更好。不妙。
[h3]薄弱的地面玩法，难以置信地有缺陷的任务执行[/h3]
太空飞行有多好，一旦你到了地面上，事情就有多糟。UI，说得客气点，就是一塌糊涂。它过度复杂且设计不足。在教程中，你被展示了如何修理某样东西。好，不错。但当我把这一课应用到我从第一艘废弃飞船上拆下来的一个坏泵上时，我的角色竟然[i]没戴头盔就走出了气闸，进入了硬真空。[/i]为什么？因为他需要机械零件，就去拿了。自动地。在太空里。没戴头盔。我赶紧把他引回舱内，结果他又……[i]做了一次。[/i]因为他必须被手动告知取消所有任务，否则一旦你的手动输入结束，他就会一直试图回到自动模式。所以，是的，不是最好的设计，而且真的没有变好。想打开一个地板储物箱？点击它……结果却得到了一个泵的控制界面。原来你必须不断右键点击来循环切换那个格子（或附近）上的物品。如果教程里讲过这个就好了。太黑看不见？打开你的工作灯。还是太黑。为什么？因为灯需要手持，而不是夹在你的宇航服上。我有一盏一直用的工作灯。你把它夹在腰带上，它就能照亮你的工作区域。这在未来是失落的技术。
[h3]对关键玩法组件毫无解释[/h3]
许多东西被暗示，但从未被解释，或以任何方式显而易见。因为非法打捞被罚了15,000美元，游戏还没真正开始就结束了，因为我已经因飞船而负债，付不起燃料费或费用。我知道你可以购买许可证来合法打捞，但我还没找到[i]在哪里或如何[/i]购买。去wiki查，结果只告诉我许可证是什么（这我早就知道）。糟糕的文档再次作祟。游戏里有战斗，但没人告诉你涉及什么，完全没有关于这些机制的教程，而且UI对这些任务和其他所有任务一样晦涩难懂，所以祝你好运。当我被抢劫时，我一直擒抱并用钢锯猛击他（因为用拳头打他毫无作用），直到他终于同意投降……两分钟后他死了，在太空里用钢锯把人打成这样是意料之中的，但有更好的办法吗？也许有？无从得知。
[h3]步行部分的画面很差[/h3]
这是一个[i]非常[/i]小的抱怨，因为与玩法相比，我通常不太在乎画面，但地面玩法的画面实在太糟糕了，值得一提。它们在20世纪90年代末都拿不出手，更别说2020年代了。这不是复古像素风格。就是纯粹的差。

[h2]底线[/h2]
这是一款[i]本应[/i]至少不错、甚至出色的游戏，也许随着时间和更多打磨，它会变得出色。我真的希望如此。但就目前而言，晦涩、笨拙的UI设计以及缺乏有意义的文档或工具提示，意味着玩它比满足更令人沮丧。这个差评我真的给得很难受，因为这里有很多潜力，而且其开发背后显然有热情，但在一些问题得到修复、游戏经过更多修订之前，它就是还没达到那个水平。
未来的科技。
[h3]对关键玩法组件毫无解释[/h3]
许多东西被暗示，却从未被解释，也以任何方式都看不出来。因为非法打捞被罚了15,000美元，我的游戏还没真正开始就结束了，因为我已经因为飞船而负债，付不起燃料费或各种费用。我知道你可以买许可证来合法打捞，但我至今还没找到[i]在哪里或怎么买[/i]。去wiki查，结果只被告知许可证是什么（这我早就知道了）。糟糕的文档又一次发威。游戏里有战斗，但没人告诉你涉及什么，完全没有关于这些机制的教程，而且UI对这些任务来说和其他一切一样晦涩难懂，所以祝你好运。当我被抢劫时，我不断擒抱他并用钢锯猛砸他（因为用拳头打他根本没用），直到他终于同意投降……两分钟后他死了，在太空里用钢锯把人打成这样，这也在意料之中，但有没有更好的办法？也许有？无从得知。
[h3]步行部分画面孱弱[/h3]
这是一个[i]非常[/i]小的抱怨，因为比起玩法，我一般真的不太在乎画面，但地面游戏的画面实在太糟糕了，值得一提。这种画面在1990年代末都拿不出手，更别说2020年代了。这不是复古像素风格。就是单纯的烂。

[h2]总结[/h2]
这是一款[i]本应[/i]至少不错、甚至出色的游戏，也许随着时间和更多打磨，它会变得如此。我真的希望如此。但就目前而言，晦涩、笨拙的UI设计，以及缺乏有意义的文档或提示，意味着玩它比满足更令人沮丧。这是一个我真的很遗憾给出的差评，因为这里有很多潜力，而且很明显其开发背后有热情，但在一些问题被修复、游戏经过更多修订之前，它就是还不行。

items.text:
Followed the tutorial prompts, trying to hunt down which of the many small numbers and readouts the game bombards you with were relevant to the task at hand when I died from lack of oxygen. I get that the game is attempting to be hardcore and an intricate simulation, but there is a point at which difficulty and intricacy stops being "Fun" and starts being "Tedious".

Maybe if the game eases up on new players someday I might pick it up again, because it does look and seem interesting as a simulation game, but as it stands the learning cost of entry is not worth what I experienced in my time of play. Dying with no credible warning isn't a learning experience, it's a quitting moment, and a warning at the start mentioning that your first few runs will end quickly doesn't excuse bad tutorial design.
items.text_zh:
跟着教程提示走，正试图从游戏向你狂轰滥炸的众多小数字和读数中找出哪些与当前任务相关时，我因缺氧而死。我明白这游戏想走硬核路线，想做复杂的模拟，但难度和复杂到了一定程度就不再是“有趣”，而是“繁琐”了。

也许哪天游戏对新手友好些了，我可能会再捡起来，因为它作为模拟游戏看起来确实挺有意思，但就目前而言，入门的学习成本不值得我在这段游玩时间里所经历的一切。在没有可信警告的情况下死亡不是学习体验，而是让人退坑的瞬间，而且开头警告说你的头几次游玩会很快结束，这并不能为糟糕的教程设计开脱。

I started the tutorial and followed the step by step prompts. A bit confusing but I'm sure I can learn it in time.
I do love the feel of the game and the detail.
However, as I was just maybe 5 to 10  minutes into the tutorial I suddenly ran out of oxogen in my ship and died.

I get that there are many systems to get aquainted with but just this brief of time into learning the game I am dead.
No explanation of why I died or any prompts beforehand. I di see a message saying I was getting lightheaded, but I was trying to learn how to rotate the ship. 

So I returned the game for now. I'm hoping to revisit this game once it gets closer to finished and maybe then it will be a bit more friendly to the new player. Wishing the best of luck to the dev as it really looks unique.

items.text:
I've seen a lot of people talk about having a hard time seeing things in this game, but I honestly feel like that's a good part of Ostranauts intended challenge. Of course you would have a hard time seeing inside an powered derelict if you don't bring a light with you, otherwise there would be little reason to use lights and no reward for learning how to optimize the way you explore.

There is a learning curve for the UI and controls, but it's something you can easily memorize in under an hour if you reference the instructions provided ingame. 

Ostranauts still lacks variety in the mid-to-end gameplay loop. Much of the implied complexity regarding managing ships and your characters has yet to be implemented, so there really isn't much left to learn after you have salvaged a dozen or so ships. The ship building process leaves a lot to be desired. The current construction mechanic is clunky to the extent of being not worth the effort of attempting more than basic repairs or modifications to existing ships.

I understand that this game is technically still in Early Access, but I would like to see more frequent updates. As of this review, we haven't seen a major update since the end of last year. That's 5 months of nothing but hotfixes and minor updates. Whether or not this continues will have a strong effect on my and likely others opinions about the game and its future.
items.text_zh:
我看到很多人说在这款游戏里很难看清东西，但老实说，我觉得这正是《Ostranauts》预期挑战中很好的一部分。当然，如果你不带灯就进入一艘无动力的废弃飞船，你会很难看清里面，否则使用灯就没什么理由，学习如何优化探索方式也就没有回报了。

UI和控制有学习曲线，但如果你参考游戏内提供的说明，不到一小时就能轻松记住。

《Ostranauts》在中后期游戏循环中仍然缺乏多样性。关于管理飞船和角色的许多隐含复杂性尚未实现，所以在你打捞了十几艘船之后，真的没什么可学的了。飞船建造过程还有很多不足之处。当前的建造机制笨拙到不值得为现有飞船尝试超出基本维修或改装的程度。

我明白这款游戏技术上仍处于抢先体验阶段，但我希望看到更频繁的更新。截至本评论，自去年年底以来我们还没有看到重大更新。那是5个月只有热修复和小更新。这种情况是否继续，将对我以及很可能其他人对这款游戏及其未来的看法产生强烈影响。

items.text:
Edit: As of April 2025, the game continues to improve on a lot of the systems I talk about, including a much better tutorial than what was present when I reviewed it.

[b]Short version review[/b]: Ostranauts blends together elements from niche games like SS13/Starsector/Delta-V Rings of Saturn/Neo Scavenger/Rimworld into a wholly new style of space salvaging game. If you have ever played Space Station 13 and enjoy the learning curve, you will be easily addicted to this game. Bugs are relatively infrequent in my play-through, but many of the game's unique and skeumorphic controls are counter-intuitive in ways that may confuse a beginner player. It's really good, but the number one thing the game needs to improve is a stronger, longer tutorial and adding regular tool-tips that clarify points of common confusion. [b]The game is absolutely worth buying in the current version, but you should join the Blue Bottle Games Discord so that you can ask people questions if you need help. They are nice folks too.[/b]

[b]Long-winded version review[/b]: Ostranauts is a derelict space ship salvaging game that blends a mix of elements that worked really well in other cult-classic modern games. In each case, the game implements them in a wholly unique way, and I'm drawing the comparisons here mainly to give an idea of what the mechanics are like to someone who has never played before. Specifically, the ship building, deconstruction, and meticulous atmospheric/electrical simulation are a lot like Space Station 13. The setting, economic simulation, and aesthetics are a lot like Starsector. The ship piloting, Newtonian physics, and realistic simulation of fuel economy are a lot like Delta-V Rings of Saturn. The way that the hand-crafted open world, inventory, action, and dialog systems work is a lot like Neo Scavenger (another game made by the same devs). And the ability to pause/speed-up time and manage multiple crew members through assigned actions and schedules is similar to Rimworld or Dwarf Fortress (more so the former). 

The game introduces a lot of mechanics that are brand-new concepts for this type of game. When you start out, you build your character's history, skill-set, and social relations (like friends and enemies who will be present in the game world) through what's essentially a choose-your-own-adventure minigame that gradually awards your character more starting cash, skills, and history at the cost of aging your character. For instance, in my first play-through, I built a character that was 28 years old, skilled in hacking, electrical engineering, and armed combat (the latter through betraying a criminal that won my character more starting cash and skills but gave me an enemy). I much later had that enemy board my ship and try to kill me. It is similar to how Mount & Blade's character story creation works, but Ostranauts does it better and with greater depth and consequences.

You start the game dirt-poor, with a hefty mortgage on your ship, space station docking fees to pay at the end of the shift, and a lousy pressure suit that can't even fit an oxygen tank (effectively an air-tight fish bowl you can use to prevent death in zero pressure which stores exactly as much air as the suit and helmet holds). The game starts on a planetoid-bound space station called "OKLG" governed by a hyper-capitalist, corporatorist, dystopian, etc government. You un-dock your ship from the space station and point the thrusters towards a nearby derelict (with instructions provided on a hand-written piece of paper stuffed into the bottom of your nav console). After a brief docking mini-game, you can board the derelict ship through the airlock and plunder all of its stowed loot. Anything on, inside, or a part of the ship can be ripped out by your character and sold for cash back at OKLG. This process of visiting a derelict, looting it, and bringing back your spoils to sell is the main game loop. Gradually, you will acquire a proper space suit, a gun to shoot pirates, and other hired crew members to split the labor of repairing your ship and stripping loot from derelicts. 

Much like piloting a real space ship (or what I can assume it is like), the game gives few safeguards to prevent you from killing yourself if you do something stupid. If you uninstall the floor fuselage of your ship, the entire atmosphere will vent out into space and suffocate you. If you attempt to fire your thrusters at full strength while docked to a derelict or station, your ship will rip itself apart (although the game will briefly warn you beforehand with a big red flashing message). If you are harvesting your first derelict with only the lousy pressure suit and let your oxygen run out, you will pass out and die. If you get stopped by the space-cops for salvaging without a license and try to kick them off your ship, they will ram your ship. If you do not regularly maintain parts of your ship, a vital piece will break at just the wrong moment and wipe out both your power and atmospherics.

In its present state, the game has a lot of depth and more than enough content for the price point. It is quite stable and has only occasional bugs and no crashes in my current play-through of ~8hrs. What's planned in the roadmap is really exciting and development seems to be ongoing with major updates coming out roughly every half a year. Understanding the jankiness of the space ship controls and game mechanics is part of the fun (and eventually everything makes sense), but the game doesn't really offer an ample tutorial for a new player to learn how everything works. Unlike Space Station 13, which has an extensive community-curated wiki that can fill in the blanks on especially obtuse mechanics, Ostranauts only has word of mouth. For that reason, I highly recommended that you join the Discord for Blue Bottle Games where friendly players can offer help if you get stuck or confused. The developers must eventually flesh out the tutorials and instructions to have the game reach a wider audience and get better reviews. However, what they have already built is a spectacularly unique game that's worth the effort of learning to play - even if you have to ping someone on Discord to figure out what a button does.
items.text_zh:
编辑：截至2025年4月，游戏在我提到的许多系统上持续改进，包括比我在评测时存在的教程要好得多的教程。

[b]简短版评测[/b]：Ostranauts将SS13/Starsector/Delta-V Rings of Saturn/Neo Scavenger/Rimworld等小众游戏的元素融合成一种全新的太空打捞游戏风格。如果你玩过《太空站13》并且喜欢那种学习曲线，你会很容易对这款游戏上瘾。在我的游玩过程中，bug相对不频繁，但游戏许多独特且拟物化的操作方式在某种程度上反直觉，可能会让新手玩家感到困惑。它真的很棒，但游戏最需要改进的头号事项是更强大、更长的教程，并添加常规的工具提示来澄清常见的困惑点。[b]当前版本的游戏绝对值得购买，但你应该加入Blue Bottle Games的Discord，这样在需要帮助时可以问别人问题。他们也是很好的人。[/b]

[b]啰嗦版评测[/b]：Ostranauts是一款废弃飞船打捞游戏，融合了在其他邪典经典现代游戏中非常奏效的多种元素。在每一种情况下，游戏都以完全独特的方式实现它们，我在这里做比较主要是为了让从未玩过的人了解这些机制是什么样的。具体来说，飞船建造、拆解以及细致的大气/电力模拟很像《太空站13》。设定、经济模拟和美学很像《Starsector》。飞船驾驶、牛顿物理学以及燃料经济的真实模拟很像《Delta-V Rings of Saturn》。手工打造的开放世界、物品栏、动作和对话系统的运作方式很像《Neo Scavenger》（同一开发商制作的另一款游戏）。而暂停/加速时间以及通过分配行动和日程来管理多名船员的能力则类似于《Rimworld》或《Dwarf Fortress》（更偏向前者）。

游戏引入了许多对这类游戏而言全新概念的机制。开始时，你通过本质上是一个选择你自己的冒险小游戏来构建角色的历史、技能组合和社会关系（比如会出现在游戏世界中的朋友和敌人），这个小游戏会逐渐奖励你的角色更多起始现金、技能和历史，代价是让你的角色变老。例如，在我的第一次游玩中，我构建了一个28岁的角色，擅长黑客、电气工程和武装战斗（后者是通过背叛一名罪犯获得的，这为我的角色赢得了更多起始现金和技能，但给了我一个敌人）。很久之后，那个敌人登上了我的飞船并试图杀我。这类似于《骑马与砍杀》的角色故事创建方式，但Ostranauts做得更好，深度和后果也更强。

你开始游戏时一贫如洗，飞船上有沉重的抵押贷款，轮班结束时还要支付空间站停靠费，还有一套糟糕的增压服，甚至装不下氧气罐（实际上就是一个气密的鱼缸，你可以用它来防止在零压力下死亡，它储存的空气量正好等于增压服和头盔所能容纳的量）。游戏开始于一个绑定在小行星上的空间站，名为“OKLG”，由一个超级资本主义、社团主义、反乌托邦等等的政府管理。你将飞船从空间站脱离，把推进器指向附近的一艘废弃飞船（导航控制台底部塞着一张手写纸条，上面提供了说明）。经过一个简短的对接小游戏后，你可以通过气闸登上废弃飞船，掠夺所有存放的战利品。飞船上、飞船内或作为飞船一部分的任何东西都可以被你的角色拆下来，带回OKLG卖钱。这种访问废弃飞船、掠夺它、把战利品带回来出售的过程就是主要游戏循环。逐渐地，你会获得一套合适的太空服、一把用来射击海盗的枪，以及其他雇佣船员来分担修理飞船和从废弃飞船剥离战利品的工作。

就像驾驶真正的太空飞船一样（或者我猜测的那样），如果你做了蠢事，游戏几乎没有保护措施来防止你害死自己。如果你卸下飞船的地板机身，整个大气会排放到太空中，让你窒息。如果你在停靠于废弃飞船或空间站时试图全功率点燃推进器，你的飞船会把自己撕裂（尽管游戏会事先用一条大大的红色闪烁消息短暂警告你）。如果你只穿着糟糕的增压服打捞你的第一艘废弃飞船，并让氧气耗尽，你会昏倒并死亡。如果你因无证打捞而被太空警察拦下，并试图把他们踢下你的飞船，他们会撞你的飞船。如果你不定期维护飞船的部件，一个关键部件会在最糟糕的时刻损坏，摧毁你的电力和大气系统。

在目前的状态下，游戏有很深的深度，并且对于这个价格来说内容绰绰有余。它相当稳定，在我目前约8小时的游玩中只有偶尔的bug，没有崩溃。路线图中计划的内容非常令人兴奋，开发似乎也在持续进行，大约每半年推出重大更新。理解飞船控制和游戏机制的粗糙感是乐趣的一部分（最终一切都会说得通），但游戏并没有真正为新玩家提供充足的教程来学习一切如何运作。与《太空站13》不同，后者有社区维护的详尽wiki可以填补特别晦涩机制的空白，而Ostranauts只有口口相传。因此，我强烈建议你加入Blue Bottle Games的Discord，友好的玩家可以在你卡住或困惑时提供帮助。开发者最终必须充实教程和说明，才能让游戏触达更广泛的受众并获得更好的评价。然而，他们已经构建出的是一款极其独特的游戏，值得付出学习游玩的努力——即使你不得不在Discord上@某人来弄清楚一个按钮是做什么的。
（说明写在一张手写的纸上，塞在你的导航控制台底部）。经过一个简短的对接小游戏后，你可以通过气闸登上那艘废弃飞船，掠夺它所有存放的物资。飞船上、飞船内或作为飞船一部分的任何东西都可以被你的角色拆下来，带回OKLG卖钱。这个造访废弃飞船、掠夺它、然后把战利品带回来出售的过程就是主要的游戏循环。渐渐地，你会获得一套像样的太空服、一把用来射击海盗的枪，以及其他雇佣的船员来分担修理飞船和从废弃飞船上拆解物资的工作。

就像驾驶一艘真正的太空船一样（或者我能想象的那样子），如果你做了什么蠢事，游戏几乎不会提供什么保护措施来防止你把自己弄死。如果你拆掉飞船的地板机身，整个大气就会泄入太空，把你憋死。如果你在停靠于废弃飞船或空间站时试图全功率点燃推进器，你的飞船会把自己撕裂（尽管游戏会事先用一条巨大的红色闪烁信息短暂警告你）。如果你只穿着那套糟糕的增压服去收割你的第一艘废弃飞船，并让氧气耗尽，你会昏过去并死掉。如果你因为无证打捞被太空警察拦下，并试图把他们踢下你的飞船，他们会撞你的飞船。如果你不经常维护飞船的部件，某个关键部件会在最糟糕的时刻坏掉，同时摧毁你的电力和大气系统。

在目前的状态下，这款游戏很有深度，就这个价格而言内容也绰绰有余。它相当稳定，在我目前约8小时的游玩过程中只有偶尔的bug，没有崩溃。路线图中计划的内容真的令人兴奋，开发似乎也在持续进行，大约每半年就会推出重大更新。理解飞船控制和游戏机制的粗糙感本身就是乐趣的一部分（最终一切都会变得合理），但游戏并没有真正为新玩家提供一个足够充分的教程来学习一切是如何运作的。与《太空站13》不同——后者有一个由社区精心维护的详尽wiki，可以填补那些特别晦涩的机制上的空白——Ostranauts只有口口相传。因此，我强烈建议你加入Blue Bottle Games的Discord，在那里友好的玩家可以在你卡住或困惑时提供帮助。开发者最终必须充实教程和说明，才能让游戏触及更广泛的受众并获得更好的评价。然而，他们已经构建出来的是一款极其独特的游戏，值得你付出学习游玩的努力——即使你得在Discord上@某个人才能弄明白一个按钮是干什么的。

items.text:
Poor dokumentation.
Poorly explained systems.
Spend hours repairing a bigger ship than yours to find out you can never really make it yours and deal with a annoying startup screen each time you open nav console.
Doesn't understand that wasting time isn't gameplay and that QoL features are desperately needed to make this game appealing.
Buggy as hell which grows more apparent the longer you play and more ambitious your salvage projects.
It runs like absolute ass. Gets worse the longer you play then restart.
Feels disrespectful to the players time when you spend so much time on fixing up a ship or merging your ship and a wreck together to not have any way, literally none, to legitimize the acquisition. Seems backwards and contributes nothing. Explanation of the dev is they dont wonna introduce a system to not blow the legality out the water. Neither sensible nor fun and most of the community IS asking for a way to make it happen.
This game could be great if the dev would bother listening to what the community wants but despite the time i had this game, these issues I have most issue with have not been addressed and have been the reason I quit the first time in the hope they were addressed when I come back.
items.text_zh:
文档很差。
系统解释得很糟糕。
花几个小时修理一艘比你自己的更大的船，结果发现你永远无法真正把它变成你的，而且每次打开导航控制台都要应付一个烦人的启动画面。
不明白浪费时间并不是游戏玩法，而生活质量功能对于让这款游戏有吸引力是迫切需要的。
bug多得像地狱，而且你玩得越久、你的打捞项目越有野心，这一点就越明显。
运行起来烂得一塌糊涂。你玩得越久就越糟，然后就得重启。
当你花那么多时间修好一艘船，或者把你的船和一艘残骸合并在一起，却没有任何办法，字面意义上没有任何办法，让这次获取合法化时，感觉这是对玩家时间的侮辱。看起来本末倒置，而且毫无贡献。开发者的解释是他们不想引入一个系统，以免把合法性彻底冲垮。既不理智也不有趣，而且大多数社区成员都在要求一种让这件事成为可能的办法。
如果开发者愿意费心听听社区想要什么，这款游戏本可以很棒，但尽管我在这款游戏上花了那么多时间，我最在意的这些问题却没有得到解决，也正是我第一次退坑的原因，当时我希望等我回来时它们已经被处理了。

items.text:
The games pretty janky. Maybe 50% done. It comes with no tutorial, no wiki, no hints on how to start.
Its like singleplayer SpaceStation 13 but without the wacky fun. Or much fun at all.
The game lore and story pages warn of stealing whole ships and getting in trouble with the law, but you cant pirate a ship and sell it off. You sorta have to cut the ship apart and sell it in pieces that fit in your little dinghy all while paying a huge mortgage on that boat four times a day.
The money curve is all off, for a game that tries to be about scavenging ships its more $/hr couriering bottles of vodka and patches between train stations. Safer too since you dont run into odd situations where you become wanted for unknown reasons and slapped with $15k fines when you're trying to get $800 to pay your docking fees. And then you come across a ship with a fusion reactor just sitting there and its worth $100k-200k and poof there goes your money troubles, and the whole point of playing.

Hold off, maybe in a year.
items.text_zh:
这游戏相当粗糙。大概完成了50%。它没有附带教程，没有wiki，没有如何开始的提示。
就像单人版的《SpaceStation 13》，但没有那种古怪的乐趣。或者说根本没什么乐趣。
游戏背景和故事页面警告说偷整艘船会惹上法律麻烦，但你不能劫持一艘船然后卖掉它。你只能把船切开，然后以能装进你那小艇的碎片形式卖掉，同时每天要为你那艘船支付四次巨额抵押贷款。
金钱曲线完全不对，对于一个试图以打捞飞船为主题的游戏来说，它更像是按小时计费在火车站之间运送伏特加酒瓶和补丁。也更安全，因为你不会遇到莫名其妙被通缉、在你试图赚800美元支付停靠费时被罚款15000美元的奇怪情况。然后你遇到一艘带有聚变反应堆的船就停在那里，它价值10万到20万美元，噗，你的金钱烦恼和玩这游戏的全部意义都消失了。

再等等吧，也许一年后。

items.text:
This game is Very Bare-Bones and has many issues but also has a lot of potential especially since this is only version 0.11.0.1
The developers have been active in discord and seeking feedback, while also helping a some people make mods for this game on the side.

The Combat and Dialogue system leave something to be desired, and it took me a couple of hours to understand the all basics of the game since it does not give you a very good guide for everything. I lost a few saves because I went into too much debt or died to some bandit punching me to exhaustion or ran my ship out of N2 fuel and ended up drifting into the abyss.
 
With how much the Devs have done and are working towards I am very hopeful of the future of this game.

I had to restart the game twice because I screwed my self over. Once because I didn't realize there is a docking fee and spent all of my money and the station wouldn't allow me to leave. The second time, I ran out of fuel and didn't have enough money to buy any because there are other fees involved in the purchase. There is definitely a learning curve to this game.

My third game seems to be going a little better after following the tutorial more closely. I think the first time I did something out of order and the tutorial stopped giving me prompts for some reason and I didn't know how I was supposed to be making money.

Will update this review once I've played a little more but it does seem fun once I got past the initial learning phase.

items.text:
This game embodies slice-of-life in a near-future dystopia. With elements that feel similar to stories like Firefly, Cowboy Bebop, and the Expanse, it conjures a world of stratified classes, desperation, and small triumphs: Getting ahead of predatory debts, finding just the right component in a locked away hulk, and sleeping soundly (if not comfortably) in a rescued tin can. You're not a hero by conventional standards - but just surviving in Ostranauts requires a sort of heroism itself. In terms of other games, it feels a bit like the end of Hardspace: Shipbreaker, where you ride off into the sunset in something to call your own.

It's not pretty. It's not much. But it's yours. And you have to earn it, each step of the way. This game is hard science fiction in that it attempts to recreate the realities of living in space, from building effective HVAC and power systems in a vacuum to the long-term health effects of zero- and low-g habitation. The one major conceit it hasn't approached has been zero-g (I probably shouldn't be walking upright while barefoot - where are those magnetized boots?).

Mostly, the core game mechanics are difficult but *fun* and *rewarding*. It's still very much an early access piece: There's no overarching or procedural story (though that's on the roadmap), there's quite a few bugs (though the developer does their best to quash game-breaking ones quickly), and the tutorial and supportive documentation are very barebones. However, what is there is amazing.

Each update brings a massive amount of content or mechanics - enough that elements of the game can change drastically. The roadmap looks promising, and the only thing not on it I'd like to see would be a more direct hand in actually breaking down ship systems on wrecks (More active shipbreaking). However, the updates have each been regular and reliable. In short, this feels what Early Access games should actually feel like. It's not everything I want in a game like this yet, but it's enough that I feel good in writing a positive review for its future.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏体现了近未来反乌托邦中的日常生活片段。其中的元素让人感觉类似于《萤火虫》、《星际牛仔》和《无垠的太空》等故事，它构筑了一个阶级分层、绝望与微小胜利并存的世界：摆脱掠夺性的债务、在锁闭的废弃船体中恰好找到合适的部件，以及在获救的罐头盒里安然入睡（即便并不舒适）。按传统标准，你并非英雄——但仅仅在奥斯特拉诺茨生存下来，本身就需要一种英雄气概。就其他游戏而言，它感觉有点像《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》的结尾，你乘着某种可以称之为自己的东西驶向夕阳。

它不漂亮。它不算什么。但它是你的。而你必须一步一步地赢得它。这款游戏是硬科幻，因为它试图再现太空生活的现实，从在真空中建造有效的暖通空调和电力系统，到零重力和低重力居住对健康的长期影响。它尚未触及的一个主要设定是零重力（我大概不该光着脚直立行走——那些磁化靴子在哪？）。

大体上，核心游戏机制很难，但*有趣*且*有回报*。它仍然非常像一款抢先体验作品：没有 overarching 或程序化生成的故事（尽管这在路线图上），有相当多的 bug（不过开发者会尽力迅速消灭那些破坏游戏的 bug），而教程和支持性文档非常简陋。然而，已有的内容非常棒。

每次更新都带来大量内容或机制——多到游戏中的某些元素可能发生剧烈变化。路线图看起来很有希望，唯一不在上面而我希望看到的，是能更直接地亲手拆解残骸上的飞船系统（更主动的拆船）。不过，每次更新都规律且可靠。简而言之，这感觉才是抢先体验游戏真正该有的样子。它还不是我想在这类游戏中想要的一切，但已经足够让我乐于为其未来写一篇好评。

items.text:
I want to start out by saying I like the idea of this game and I think it will be a great game some day. While certain parts of the game are well explained (navigation, life support), large portions of the game will require you to post threads on reddit begging for answers. Why am I locked out of the delivery location of this mission? How does the dialogue minigame work? How am I supposed to afford the 8 kg of helium my reactor chews through every single ♥♥♥♥♥♥ minute? WHY ON EARTH CAN'T I ROTATE ITEMS IN MY INVENTORY?!

There is some amazing world building going on here, and I strongly urge people to support it. The harsh, unforgiving gameplay would be an absolute blast if things were a bit more clear, but as it is, it's like a very challenging quest where you get to the end and realize you went the wrong way.

I have a sneaking suspicion that somebody is going to respond to this and reveal to me that most of my confusion is self-inflicted somehow.
items.text_zh:
我想先说，我喜欢这款游戏的理念，我认为它有一天会成为一款很棒的游戏。虽然游戏的某些部分解释得很好（导航、生命维持），但游戏的大部分内容都需要你在reddit上发帖求答案。为什么我被锁在这个任务的交付地点之外？对话小游戏是怎么运作的？我到底该怎么负担得起我的反应堆每♥♥♥♥♥♥分钟就消耗掉的8公斤氦气？我到底为什么不能在物品栏里旋转物品？！

这里有一些惊人的世界构建，我强烈建议大家支持它。如果事情能更清楚一些，这种严酷、无情的玩法绝对会非常过瘾，但就目前而言，这就像是一个极具挑战性的任务，你走到最后才发现自己走错了路。

我隐隐怀疑会有人回复这个，并向我揭示我的大部分困惑其实都是我自己造成的。

items.text:
While the game seems like it has promise, the current version seems unplayably complex having too many complex simulations layered on top of each other before you can even get anywhere, with insufficent tutorialization and feedback.

My playthrough was non-stop confusion. I definitely crashed my ship at least once trying to get to a derelict, and then when I got there I was confounded by the door and lack of lighting and O2. Evenutally I realized that you have a light and vac suit in your inventory (I had been looking for them in/near the airlock) and I eventually figured out that I can pick up items off the ground, but I was unable to figure out how to dismantle ship systems and then kept getting caught by a patrol boat and didn't feel like dealing with yet another minigame while I was still trying to figure out how looting/salvaging a ship worked. The game needs to manage complexity better.
items.text_zh:
虽然这款游戏看起来很有前途，但当前版本似乎复杂到无法游玩，在你甚至还没能取得任何进展之前，就有太多复杂的模拟系统层层叠加在一起，教程和反馈也不够充分。

我的游玩过程就是不停地在困惑中度过。我在试图前往一艘废弃飞船时至少撞毁了自己的飞船一次，然后当我到达那里时，又被门、缺乏照明和氧气搞得一头雾水。最终我意识到自己的物品栏里有一盏灯和一件宇航服（我之前一直在气闸门里/附近找它们），我最终也弄明白了可以捡起地上的物品，但我无法弄清楚如何拆解飞船系统，然后不断被巡逻艇抓住，而在我还在试图弄清楚如何掠夺/打捞一艘飞船的时候，实在不想再应付又一个小游戏。这款游戏需要更好地管理复杂性。

items.text:
CHANGED FROM NEGATIVE TO POSITIVE BELOW

I want to like this. I do. but my God. I get wanting to simulate a difficult life, that's what I WANTED. Fighting the environment is cool, fighting enemies? Dope. Fighting the controls and UI? That's like a Souls game that needs a button combo to roll. I should be punished for bad decision making - not due to how fast I can read a wiki-how. Add a tutorial where you learn to fly a ship and THEN stick me in a Space Toyota Corolla and I'd be okay with it because I had a chance to learn. If I wasn't paying attention while my hand was being held that's on me. Soft locking me in the first 5 minutes twice because I wasn't told what to do in time is insufferable. No, a text box I have to open in a separate menu while moving like a piss-missile and expected to do 10 things I've never done before is NOT a substitute. All that brought me right to the refund page. 

Look if you are a masochist and want to pull your hair out to learn, go hog wild man. If you're like me and expected a challenge that was fair but punishing, I'd sit this one out for a bit. And believe you me, I saw the same comments you are seeing and thought "Meh, can't be that bad" it is, man. Devs, you guys are onto something here, just please think about adding a chance to learn the game. Ivy Tech doesn't have a class for this and I don't feel like edging an stroke to go through the first docking section 100x. I'll keep an eye on this and if something comes along I'll consider rebuying but until then, to the shelf it goes.

EDIT: After a few year, I gave this another shot and I'm blown away. There's a decent tutorial, things are explained to you, albeit pretty basically, but with how much you can do with the mechanics I think it's serviceable. Though I didn't see it until now, the devs reached out with genuine intent to hear what my issues were and even if I didn't get the chance to reply, I feel like they took it into account with the few updates. this is now one of my new addictions, and if you don't mind a steep learning curve and typical early access issues, I can't recommend it enough
items.text_zh:
以下内容从负面变为正面

我想喜欢这个。我真的想。但我的天啊。我理解想要模拟艰难的生活，那正是我想要的。与环境抗争很酷，与敌人战斗？太棒了。与操作和界面抗争？那就像是一个需要按键组合才能翻滚的魂类游戏。我应该因为糟糕的决策而受到惩罚——而不是因为我读wiki-how的速度有多快。加一个教程，让你学会驾驶飞船，然后把我塞进一辆太空丰田卡罗拉，我会接受的，因为我有机会学习。如果在我被手把手教的时候我没注意，那是我的问题。在头5分钟里因为没人及时告诉我该做什么而两次把我软锁，这让人无法忍受。不，一个我必须在移动中像尿导弹一样打开单独菜单里的文本框，还指望我做10件我从未做过的事，这不是替代品。所有这些直接把我带到了退款页面。

听着，如果你是个受虐狂，想揪着头发学习，那就尽情去吧，老兄。如果你像我一样，期待一个公平但严苛的挑战，我会暂时不碰这个。相信我，我看到了你看到的那些同样的评论，心想“嗯，不可能那么糟”，它就是那么糟，老兄。开发者们，你们在这里有点东西，只是请考虑加一个学习游戏的机会。Ivy Tech没有这门课，我也不想为了通过第一个对接部分100次而边缘到中风。我会继续关注这个，如果有进展我会考虑重新购买，但在此之前，它就上架吃灰吧。

编辑：几年后，我又试了一次，我被震撼了。有一个像样的教程，事情会向你解释，虽然相当基础，但考虑到你能用这些机制做多少事，我觉得它够用了。虽然我直到现在才看到，但开发者们带着真诚的意图联系我，想听听我的问题是什么，即使我没机会回复，我觉得他们在几次更新中考虑到了这一点。这现在成了我的新瘾之一，如果你不介意陡峭的学习曲线和典型的抢先体验问题，我强烈推荐它

- The game still annoys with dissapearing hull parts (floors, walls) when you try to contruct them no one item after another (EXAMPLE: you move a wall, place it somewhere and then in the mid of work just go to do something else, if you save-load, it will dissapear, unless you will build this wall to 100% complete)

在我第一篇评测的5年后，我又写了一篇。
- 终于，游戏崩溃的次数比之前少了大概10倍
- 游戏仍然会因为当你试图一个接一个地建造船体部件（地板、墙壁）时它们消失而让人恼火（例如：你移动一堵墙，把它放在某个地方，然后在工作途中去做别的事情，如果你保存再加载，它就会消失，除非你把这堵墙建到100%完成）

- 界面几乎没有任何积极或有帮助的改动（感谢帮助指南吧……终于）
- 我还没玩到开头之后更多内容，但在4-5小时的挫败之后，我认为这款游戏只会对那些喜欢探索并在过程中受苦的人感兴趣）
- 要想玩得稍微好一点，你仍然需要一个社区MOD“Performance Optimizer Mods”，这样你的游戏才不会那么杂乱。这太疯狂了！

我不推荐这款游戏，除非它价值不超过5美元，并且带有通知说明新玩家会受苦！\m/

items.text:
I am very, very annoyed with the direction this EA is going. 
[list]
[*] UI is bad and there seems to be no efforts to improve it.
[*] Graphics is bad - dark, cluttered spaces that make your eyes hurt - and it becomes worse.
[*] Social interactions - I outright hate those, 20 different lines clutter aforementioned bad UI and maybe 3 of them are useful.
[*] Quests are random generated pointless nonsence, and in latest version you are bombarded by them
[*] No adequate starmap, local maps, general derelict plans etc. 
[/list]
Game is bad at telling you what happens around you, what happens with you and very, very bad at telling you what your are supposed to do.

It's playable, yes, and there are [i]some[/i] imporvement but it was to pain to play back in 2020 and is pain to play now.

IDK, maybe I'll check in another 2 to 4 years. But for now I better play again NEO Scavenger again, at least THAT game was able to explain that I am in pain because of wearing a left shoe on the right leg...
items.text_zh:
我对这个EA游戏的发展方向感到非常、非常恼火。
[list]
[*] UI很糟糕，而且似乎没有任何改进的努力。
[*] 画面很差——黑暗、杂乱的空间让你的眼睛疼——而且还在变得更糟。
[*] 社交互动——我彻底讨厌这些，20条不同的台词塞满了上述糟糕的UI，也许其中3条有用。
[*] 任务是随机生成的无意义废话，而在最新版本中你被它们狂轰滥炸
[*] 没有合适的星图、本地地图、一般的废弃飞船平面图等。
[/list]
游戏很不擅长告诉你周围发生了什么、你身上发生了什么，而且非常、非常不擅长告诉你应该做什么。

它是可玩的，是的，而且有[i]一些[/i]改进，但在2020年玩起来很痛苦，现在玩起来也很痛苦。

不知道，也许再过2到4年我会再看看。但就目前而言，我宁愿再玩一次NEO Scavenger，至少那个游戏能够解释我因为把左脚的鞋穿在右脚上而感到疼痛……

observations.description: 游戏在告知周围发生什么、玩家发生什么以及该做什么方面非常糟糕
observations.evidence: Game is bad at telling you what happens around you, what happens with you and very, very bad at telling you what your are supposed to do
observations.evidence_zh: 游戏很不擅长告诉你周围发生了什么、你身上发生了什么，而且非常、非常不擅长告诉你应该做什么

items.text:
I'm giving this game a thumbs up as its got great potential I've got 22 hours played when writing this review.

I've blundered my way through managing to recover and repair one of the ships from the ship graveyard.

A tutorial that takes you though the basics of things would make this game more user friendly from the start. there is no guide to what you need on a ship first few times I took over a new ship I was stranded in space once I un-docked from my pod as i had no fuel or rcs components. I managed to get the Core started but a few switches and levers don't appear to do anything at the time of writing. 

I've also accidentally turned of the fusion core instead of charging batteries also leaving me stranded.

Also it would be nice to be able to lock doors to stop crew opening them as I've accidentally opened an internal door where I had one of my crew safe as they had no suit and my character decided to go in and take something from the room exposing the crew to void space and didn't get chance to close door before it was too late.

Sometime the character pathing isn't very clever and gets stuck, and sometimes there is a task set build something and the character doesn't do it and you can't see a reason for it.

Character attributes/feeling/environment could do with a mouse over help option as my character has just decided to give up work and just keep dong social things and now is stuck in this loop and dies every time I reload.

This may sound like a negative review but the game actually has a lot of fun bits, exploring random ships recovering parts expanding repairing your own ship, selling recovered items. 
Its a got a very good foundation that it is building on and really looking forward to more content
items.text_zh:
我给这款游戏点了赞，因为它潜力巨大。写这篇评测时我已经玩了22个小时。

我跌跌撞撞地摸索着，成功从飞船坟场中回收并修复了一艘飞船。

一个带你了解基础操作的教程会让这款游戏从一开始就更友好。游戏里没有指南告诉你一艘飞船需要什么。头几次我接管新飞船时，从我的太空舱脱离后就被困在太空中，因为我没有燃料或RCS组件。我设法启动了核心，但写这篇评测时，有几个开关和拉杆似乎没有任何作用。

我还曾不小心关掉了聚变核心而不是给电池充电，结果也让我被困住了。

另外，如果能锁门来阻止船员开门就好了，因为我曾不小心打开了一扇内部舱门，当时我有一名船员在里面很安全，因为他们没有宇航服，而我的角色却决定进去从房间里拿东西，导致船员暴露在真空太空中，还没来得及关门就为时已晚。

有时候角色的寻路不太聪明，会卡住，有时候设置了建造某物的任务，角色却不去做，你也看不出原因。

角色属性/感受/环境如果能有个鼠标悬停帮助选项就好了，因为我的角色刚刚决定放弃工作，一直做社交的事情，现在陷入了这个循环，每次我重新加载都会死。

这听起来可能像是一篇负面评测，但这款游戏其实有很多有趣的方面，探索随机飞船、回收部件、扩建修复自己的飞船、出售回收的物品。
它有一个非常好的基础，并且正在此基础上不断发展，我真的很期待更多内容。

observations.description: 缺少教程，游戏初期不友好
observations.evidence: A tutorial that takes you though the basics of things would make this game more user friendly from the start.
observations.evidence_zh: 一个带你了解基础操作的教程会让这款游戏从一开始就更易于上手。

items.text:
Although it has a VERY confusing introduction, this is a fascinating game that reminds me a lot of the (unfortunately no longer developed?) "Objects in Space" and of the vector-graphics-space-horror game "Duskers."

I REALLY hope these guys are able to make a more user-friendly onboarding! The first mission is ludicrously hard to figure out without a video walkthrough.

items.text:
This game is only suitable for a specific group of gamers. 
I think people who liked Neo Scavenger will also like this one. 

It reminds me of good old C64 times.  The manual is useless, and there are barely any ingame hints. There is a readme file in the main folder with some essentials, but actually it is quite fun to figure things out yourself. 
 
Currently the game runs quite stable, although I had one catastrophic failure that destroyed my save game. There are backups available, but make sure to make extra copies as these backups can get corrupted, too. 

Despite the missing content this game is quite some fun already now. 
It was quite annoying to find those leaks. I spend an hour to spot that last leak hidden which pointed out to be a damaged floor hidden under a battery. With the recent update it became much easier to spot those leaks. 
There seems to be limit on how much you can carry, so you can stack crates into each other and basically carry a whole starship around. Easy enough to scrap one hopelessly damaged ship and use the parts to repair a decent one.  

I have not figured out yet how to recruit another crew member. I guess my chosen character traits were too bad for that strange "socializing" combat game.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏只适合特定的一群玩家。
我觉得喜欢《Neo Scavenger》的人也会喜欢这款游戏。

它让我想起了美好的C64时代。手册毫无用处，游戏内的提示也几乎没有。主文件夹里有一个readme文件，里面有一些要点，但实际上自己摸索出东西来还挺有趣的。

目前游戏运行相当稳定，尽管我遇到过一次灾难性故障，毁掉了我的存档。有备份可用，但一定要额外多复制几份，因为这些备份也可能损坏。

尽管内容有所缺失，这款游戏现在就已经相当有趣了。
找出那些泄漏点相当烦人。我花了一个小时才找到最后那个隐藏的泄漏点，结果发现是藏在电池下面的一块损坏地板。随着最近的更新，找出这些泄漏点变得容易多了。
携带量似乎有上限，所以你可以把箱子套进彼此里面，基本上能带着一整艘星际飞船到处跑。把一艘彻底损坏的飞船拆解掉，用零件修好一艘还不错的飞船，这足够简单。

我还没搞明白怎么招募另一名船员。我猜我选择的角色特质对那个奇怪的“社交”战斗游戏来说太差了。

items.text:
A quick preface here: This review is based on the early access release as of 12th October 2020. This game is [b]BROKEN[/b] and needs a fair bit of patience to play. There is only the one save slot and it's easy to overwrite it and wind up with all your effort so far being lost. This is very-very Early-Early Access, bear that in mind.

That said, it's a great game (the huge number of bugs, some game breaking, notwithstanding). The lack of a tutorial makes it hard at first to get your head around it but basically you play a spacer in a huge space junk yard. You start off with a little money and a tiny shuttle, you have to buy the gear you need and fly to, then fix up, a derelict space ship. That's pretty much it at the moment but as you have an extremely complex control system where you have to scavenge parts from a number of hulks before you can fix up the trash ship of your dreams, and everything is included: Floors/Walls to make it airtight, doors to compartmentalise, temp gauges/heaters/coolers to control the temp, O2/N2/air pumps to control the pressure and breathability, beds, fridges, toilets, sinks, food, water, money, power plants, batteries, wiring, lights... believe me, it's enough to be going on with. 

It's pretty complex and you'll probably kill yourself several time learning the ropes (there is not as much as a warning that you're about to do something really stupid when you lift a floor panel while out of an EVA suit and expose yourself to hard vacuum). The game allows you to do so much, but at the same time doesn't hold your hand at all. Definitely worth putting on your wish list if you don't like EA and buggy games, worth a punt if you can put up with all the above.
items.text_zh:
先来个简短的前言：这篇评测基于2020年10月12日的抢先体验版本。这款游戏是[b]坏掉的[/b]，玩起来需要相当的耐心。只有一个存档槽，很容易覆盖它，结果之前所有的努力都白费了。这是非常非常早期的抢先体验，请记住这一点。

话虽如此，这仍是一款很棒的游戏（尽管有大量的bug，有些还会破坏游戏进程）。没有教程一开始让人很难理解，但基本上你扮演一个在巨大太空废料场的太空人。你一开始有一点钱和一艘小穿梭机，你必须购买所需的装备，飞到一艘废弃的太空船那里，然后把它修好。目前差不多就是这样，但由于你有一个极其复杂的控制系统，你必须从多艘废船中搜集零件，才能修好你梦想中的垃圾船，而且一切都包含在内：地板/墙壁让它气密，门来分隔舱室，温度计/加热器/冷却器来控制温度，O2/N2/空气泵来控制压力和可呼吸性，床、冰箱、马桶、水槽、食物、水、钱、发电厂、电池、电线、灯……相信我，这些足够你忙一阵子了。

它相当复杂，你可能会在摸索过程中把自己弄死好几次（当你没穿EVA服就掀起一块地板面板，把自己暴露在硬真空中时，连一句警告都没有，告诉你即将做一件非常愚蠢的事）。游戏允许你做很多事情，但同时完全不手把手教你。如果你不喜欢抢先体验和满是bug的游戏，绝对值得加入愿望单；如果你能忍受以上所有问题，值得一试。

items.text: DO NOT BUY THIS GAME NOW. This game has so much potential, the concept alone is great. But good god the amount of game breaking bugs in this game is downright insane, its inexcusable. items.text:
Ethan Duarte. Skilled in designing and building software, is significantly smarter than most. Despite being uncomfortable around other people (especially strangers) they are well-groomed, altruistic and yearning for intimacy. After cutting his teeth as a shipbreaker, spending his spare time hacking radio stations to play his favourite songs; he decided to take a chance at making his name after inheriting the salvage pod Mesmer Thought.
After locating a nearby derelict, the proximity sensor beep into life as he slowly, and nervously, docks with the vessel. After several tense minutes, he is successful. Equipping his pressure suit and helmet he prepares to disembark and discover what awaits.
“Foreign object approaching”.
“Foreign object collision”.
Ethan awakes surrounded by carnage and debris, trapped and unable to move. He is hungry, he is anxious, he is alone. He is running out of oxygen.
“Ethan Duarte has a headache”.
“Ethan Duarte stares longingly at an old photo”.
“Ethan Duarte feels that family has their back”.
“Ethan Duarte has all the personal space they need”.
Moments later, Ethan asphyxiates and dies.

Ostranauts is an extremely rough Early Access. There are a few bugs, very little is explained well and it took a lot of trial and error to figure out how to even navigate ship let alone dock. Yet it has the capability to be an incredible story generator which has piqued my interest. Neo Scavenger meets Elite - I eagerly await the continued development of this title."
items.text_zh:
Ethan Duarte。擅长设计和构建软件，比大多数人聪明得多。尽管在他人（尤其是陌生人）周围感到不自在，但他仪容整洁、利他且渴望亲密关系。在作为拆船工磨练技艺、利用业余时间入侵广播电台播放他最喜欢的歌曲之后；他在继承了打捞舱“Mesmer Thought”后决定抓住机会闯出名堂。
在定位到附近的一艘废弃飞船后，接近传感器嗡嗡作响，他缓慢而紧张地与那艘船对接。经过几分钟的紧张操作，他成功了。装备好压力服和头盔，他准备下船去发现等待着他的是什么。
“外来物体正在接近”。
“外来物体碰撞”。
Ethan在残骸和碎片中醒来，被困住无法移动。他饿了，他焦虑，他孤身一人。他的氧气正在耗尽。
“Ethan Duarte感到头痛”。
“Ethan Duarte渴望地盯着一张旧照片”。
“Ethan Duarte觉得家人支持着他”。
“Ethan Duarte拥有他所需要的全部个人空间”。
片刻之后，Ethan窒息而死。

《Ostranauts》是一款极其粗糙的抢先体验游戏。有一些bug，很少有东西被解释清楚，需要大量试错才能弄清楚如何驾驶飞船，更不用说对接了。然而它有能力成为一个令人难以置信的故事生成器，这引起了我的兴趣。Neo Scavenger遇上Elite——我热切期待这款游戏的持续开发。”

items.text:
So I wanna talk about what this big blue "thumbs up" means because for this particular game I think that needs some framing. 

"Do you recommend this game?" 

It's an early access title. It's a very rough early access title. It's going to be missing features, it's going to be buggy, it's in dire need of a full tutorial. As far as early access titles go it makes Bannerlord look like a 1.0 release. Would I recommend this game to someone's who's looking for a complete and playable experience? No. 

But I feel like I can't not recommend the game, with some key bits of context there. 

First, I am an early access vet. I bought Kenshi back on Steam's first Greenlight ever. Early Access is not "buy a game to play while minor bugs get ironed out" to me. The way to look at this is a pre-order, with the opportunity to help the one-man band of a Developer that Dan is get the game in working order. I'm on the discord, I'm sharing bugs and my idea of how the game should be, and Dan is super receptive to all the feedback. The game's gotten at least 3 to 5 patches in its first week which for a single dev I think says a lot. He interacts with the community regularly, and as a long time fan of his other super polished and amazing survival title Neo Scavenger I know he has a penchant for quality work. 

So I feel like, based on Blue Bottle's reputation, based on their involvement, their recent road map, their receptiveness to the community and work to really make the game better, I can recommend Ostranauts. I can recommend it for what it could and likely will be, based on those factors, and the good will Neo Scavenger has built Blue Bottle as a diligent and reputable Indie dev. 

If you're looking for an out of box, plug and play space scavenging survival, hold off a bit. Give it some time, put it on your "Follow" list, let the Early Access crew deal with the growing pains for you. If this is the kind of game you can see yourself enjoying in the future, and you're someone who actually gets the point of Early Access not being a pre-release demo, hop on, play the game, find your derelict, patch it up, probably run into something catastrophic, and catch us on the Discord. 

This game oozes potential, and the dev has already shown a commitment to finishing a quality game. With their reputation, I'm confident in recommending Ostranauts for what it could be, and as an Early Access title I'd hope you can judge it on those merits.
items.text_zh:
所以我想谈谈这个大大的蓝色“竖起大拇指”意味着什么，因为对于这款特定的游戏，我认为这需要一些背景说明。

“你推荐这款游戏吗？”

这是一款抢先体验作品。它是一款非常粗糙的抢先体验作品。它会缺少功能，会有bug，它急需一个完整的教程。就抢先体验作品而言，它让《骑马与砍杀2：霸主》看起来像是一个1.0正式版。我会把这款游戏推荐给那些在寻找完整可玩体验的人吗？不会。

但我觉得我无法不推荐这款游戏，这里有一些关键的背景信息。

首先，我是抢先体验的老手。我在Steam有史以来第一次Greenlight的时候就买了《剑士》。对我来说，抢先体验不是“买一款游戏来玩，同时小bug被修复”。看待这件事的方式是把它当作预购，同时有机会帮助Dan这个一人乐队般的开发者让游戏进入可运行状态。我在Discord上，我分享bug和我对游戏应该怎样的想法，而Dan对所有反馈都非常乐于接受。游戏在第一周就至少发布了3到5个补丁，对于一个单人开发者来说，我认为这很说明问题。他经常与社区互动，作为他另一款极其精致且出色的生存游戏《新拾荒者》的长期粉丝，我知道他有追求高质量作品的倾向。

所以我觉得，基于Blue Bottle的声誉，基于他们的参与、他们最近的路线图、他们对社区的接纳以及真正让游戏变得更好的努力，我可以推荐《Ostranauts》。基于这些因素，以及《新拾荒者》为Blue Bottle建立的作为一个勤勉且信誉良好的独立开发者的善意，我可以为它可能成为、并且很可能会成为的样子而推荐它。

如果你在寻找一款开箱即用、即插即用的太空拾荒生存游戏，那就再等等。给它一些时间，把它加入你的“关注”列表，让抢先体验的玩家们替你承受成长的阵痛。如果这是那种你觉得自己将来会喜欢的游戏，而且你是真正理解抢先体验不是预发布试玩版的人，那就上车吧，玩这款游戏，找到你的废弃飞船，把它修补好，很可能会遇到某种灾难性的事情，然后在Discord上和我们碰面。

这款游戏充满了潜力，而开发者已经展现出了完成一款高质量游戏的承诺。凭借他们的声誉，我有信心为《Ostranauts》可能成为的样子而推荐它，作为一款抢先体验作品，我希望你能基于这些优点来评判它。

observations.description: 缺少完整教程
observations.evidence: it's in dire need of a full tutorial
observations.evidence_zh: 它急需一个完整的教程

items.text:
Like the others say, the game has bugs and a lack of content. But I believe, based on my experience with watching Neo Scavenger, that the game will eventually be excellent. 

The game starts with your character on a ship where you can choose your characters gender and pronouns. You can also randomize the avatar's face but I don't believe customization is in the game. You continue by choosing your career and answering a questionnaire about how you deal with particular situations nets your character skills and money. Once you complete that you can use some of the money to buy equipment for work. Currently it is somewhat limited with a crowbar, laser system (that I wasn't able to figure out how to use), work flashlight, food (which gave one of my characters food allergies and killed them). You can also choose the characters attributes like strong, feeble, genius. I'm uncertain at this time how much of an affect this plays on the game but I know that the food sensitivity one works as do some of the ones that govern your character's emotions.

Once you've done all of that, you can finalize your character and launch on your space ship. When you do that you are transitioned from the starting area to a small single room ship. Currently there is no tutorial so you'll need to click around and figure out how to do certain things. Sitting at the Navigation chair allows you to pilot your ship while looking at a cool 70s (think Ridley Scott's Aliens) terminal. You can lock on to a specific destination and fly over to it. This requires some skill as it is kind of easy to rotate uncontrollably until you get a feel for the controls. Once you get close to your target a proximity klaxon will start beeping as your increase your distance. You switch over to docking mode, connect to the target and dock your ship. Docking relies on you lining up your ship so that the docking clamps can connect. This isn't too hard unless you are moving too fast. 

Having connected successfully to the derelict ship, the time has come for you to go and scavenge for parts. Because your character is new and doesn't have a lot of money, you are initially required to scavenge in lunges because you don't have the EVA suit and when you put on your space suit, you only have air for a couple of minutes so you have to get into the derelict, uninstall whatever scrap you want and then get back to your ship before passing out and dying. If you manage to get this far you will come to the only problem I've found with the game so far. 

Your ship, until you find a generator, runs on batteries that drains as your ship produces thrust, heats the interior, produces air, et al. Once that drains down all power is shut off on board your ship and you can no longer control whichever direction you are going in or even see how far other things are. Additionally, there isn't a way (that I have found) to recharge the batteries. So in my case I was able to make one derelict run and then had to head back to the K-leg (first space station) where I became marooned because I couldn't figure out how to get more energy for my ship. I was able to make a decent amount of money selling the scrap that I had taken from the derelict though and bought more drinks and food.

While stuck at the station I was able to talk to the other friendly NPCs and test out the interaction/diplomacy screen. You are able to recruit other characters to join your crew but since you don't have beds, restroom facilities, etc I can't see how it would help. 

 I am recommending the game but I would say wait for the Developer to release a patch fixing the biggest issues and then go ahead and buy the game if you are interested in a hardish science fiction space game.
items.text_zh:
就像其他人说的那样，这款游戏有bug，内容也不足。但根据我观看《Neo Scavenger》的经验，我相信这款游戏最终会非常出色。

游戏开始时，你的角色在一艘飞船上，你可以选择角色的性别和代词。你还可以随机化头像的面部，但我认为游戏中没有自定义功能。接着你选择职业，并回答一份关于你如何应对特定情况的问卷，这会为你的角色提供技能和金钱。完成这些后，你可以用一些钱购买工作装备。目前装备有些有限，包括一根撬棍、激光系统（我没能弄明白怎么用）、工作手电筒、食物（这让我其中一个角色得了食物过敏并死了）。你还可以选择角色的属性，比如强壮、虚弱、天才。目前我不确定这对游戏有多大影响，但我知道食物敏感属性是有效的，还有一些控制角色情绪的属性和有效。

完成所有这些后，你可以最终确定你的角色并发射你的太空船。当你这样做时，你会从起始区域过渡到一个小型单间飞船。目前没有教程，所以你需要四处点击来弄清楚如何做某些事情。坐在导航椅上可以让你驾驶飞船，同时看着一个很酷的70年代风格（想想雷德利·斯科特的《异形》）终端。你可以锁定一个特定目的地并飞过去。这需要一些技巧，因为在你熟悉控制之前，很容易不受控制地旋转。一旦你接近目标，随着距离增加，一个接近警报器会开始发出哔哔声。你切换到对接模式，连接到目标并停靠你的飞船。对接依赖于你将飞船对齐，以便对接夹能够连接。这不太难，除非你移动得太快。

成功连接到废弃飞船后，是时候去搜寻零件了。因为你的角色是新手，没有很多钱，你最初需要分次搜寻，因为你没有EVA宇航服，而当你穿上太空服时，你只有几分钟的空气，所以你必须进入废弃飞船，卸下你想要的任何废料，然后在昏倒和死亡之前回到你的飞船。如果你设法走到这一步，你会遇到我目前发现的游戏中唯一的问题。

你的飞船，在你找到发电机之前，靠电池运行，当你的飞船产生推力、加热内部、产生空气等时，电池会耗尽。一旦电池耗尽，飞船上的所有电源都会关闭，你不再能控制你前进的方向，甚至看不到其他东西有多远。此外，我没有找到给电池充电的方法。所以在我的情况下，我只能进行一次废弃飞船之旅，然后不得不返回K-leg（第一个空间站），在那里我因为无法弄清楚如何为飞船获取更多能量而被困。不过，我通过出售从废弃飞船上拿到的废料赚了不少钱，并买了更多饮料和食物。

被困在空间站时，我能够与其他友好的NPC交谈，并测试互动/外交界面。你能够招募其他角色加入你的船员，但既然你没有床、洗手间设施等，我看不出这有什么帮助。

我推荐这款游戏，但我会说等开发者发布补丁修复最大的问题，然后如果你对一款偏硬核的科幻太空游戏感兴趣，就去买吧。
它会有什么帮助。
